## Got an idea?

Want to start or showcase a photonics project with the society? [Get in touch](mailto:photonics.society@ucl.ac.uk) or message us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/ucl-photonics-society/) — we'd love to hear from you! 💡
